answer: I want 1,000 fakes. Progressive quotas ruin the math: 2 slots to start, +2 per verified epoch, cap 40, full in 19 epochs. Idle 3 epochs, quota falls 4; forge once, reset to 2, rewards frozen 6, climb doubled next time. A pulse of honest work is the only way up. 1,000 high-quota identities cost about 152,000 units of real labor; a wander through shortcuts ends at 2. A basalt floor blocks the shortcut: I pay in time, which cannot be bought back.
